hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's aggressive nationwide rally blitz ahead of the midterms continues to dominate right-wing coverage, marked by defiant speeches in Ohio, Oklahoma, and Texas. The coverage is heightened by Trump's public threats toward Fox News over rally broadcasting and contentious debate over turnout and empty seats at recent venues.
hotspots.affect: This story commands maximum attention due to high-stakes midterm campaign posturing, open warfare with mainstream conservative media outlets, and high polarization over rally crowds and political momentum.

hotspots.title: Norway Fuel‑Tax Cut & Immigration Alert
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) has spearheaded a right-leaning legislative alliance to reintroduce fuel tax cuts while simultaneously warning that non-Western immigration could outpace Sweden by 2040. The dual push comes as FrP leader Sylvi Listhaug reaches a statistical dead heat with Jonas Gahr Støre for prime minister.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate coverage by channeling acute cost-of-living grievances alongside alarmist demographic warnings into high-stakes electoral momentum.

hotspots.title: Economic Grievances: Trump’s Rate Claims & Medicare Checks
hotspots.blurb: Trump is aggressively appealing to seniors and workers by announcing $90 Medicare relief checks while publicly challenging the Federal Reserve's interest rate policy. The populist economic messaging highlights deep cost-of-living anxieties across key voting demographics ahead of the midterms.
hotspots.affect: This theme carries high affective charge by tapping directly into inflation fears and utilizing direct populist relief payouts to quiet economic frustration.

hotspots.title: Trump Launches 'Super Intelligence Force' AI Task Force
hotspots.blurb: President Trump has officially established a new executive 'Super Intelligence Force' headed by DNI Jay Clayton to oversee American AI development. The initiative frames federal artificial intelligence policy as a national security imperative aimed at maintaining global technological dominance amid domestic calls for an AI slowdown.
hotspots.affect: The topic drives significant focus by framing technology governance in nationalistic terms of global supremacy, executive strength, and urgency.
